mapper.select: SELECT skl_cd FROM hr.cand_skl WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd
SELECT cntct_dt,cntct_stts_cd,memo_desc AS memo,rcrd_user_id AS user_id,created_at FROM hr.cand_cntct_hist WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY cntct_dt DESC,created_at DESC,cntct_hist_id DESC

SELECT n.need_id,o.oppt_id,o.oppt_nm,n.job_cd,n.bgn_ym,n.expc_untprc_amt AS monthly_price,c.hope_untprc_amt FROM hr.cand c JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.job_cd=c.job_cd AND n.use_yn='Y' JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id AND o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.cntct_stts_cd IN ('NONE','DONE','INTV') AND (n.grd_cd IS NULL OR n.grd_cd=c.grd_cd) AND c.asgn_psbl_dt <= (to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date ORDER BY n.bgn_ym,o.oppt_id,n.need_id
mapper.update: UPDATE hr.cand SET dev_id=#{developerId},cntct_stts_cd='SIGNED',updated_by=#{actor} WHERE cand_id=#{id} AND dev_id IS NULL
